plugins.name: assets
plugins.description: Provides configuration authoring, session and subject metadata discovery skills for sollertia-shared-assets. Includes MCP bindings for reading, writing, and validating every Sollertia platform shared asset (configuration files, session YAMLs, subject records, and task templates). Backed by the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa); system-specific record schemas live in the per-system companion plugin (e.g. the mesoscope plugin).

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Provides Unity Editor integration skills for the sollertia-unity-tasks project. Authors task prefabs, manages VR scenes, drives Play Mode, validates task templates against prefab state, and documents the MQTT contract with sollertia-experiment, the CreateTask generation pipeline, the inlined GIMBL VR framework, and Editor-time scene setup. Uses the Unity relay served by the assets plugin's slsa MCP server and the McpBridge editor plugin.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Provides the system-agnostic core skills for sollertia-experiment: acquisition system design and runtime patterns, hardware interfaces, system setup and health checks, and session lifecycle management. System-specific skills live in dedicated companion plugins (e.g. the 'mesoscope' plugin). Includes MCP bindings for Zaber motor management, session preprocessing, and animal migration.

plugins.name: mesoscope
plugins.description: Provides Mesoscope-VR system-specific skills covering the sollertia-experiment system-specific layer (hardware subsystem inventory and MesoscopeSystemConfiguration, the runtime state machine, orchestrator, UIs, `sle mesoscope` CLI, and per-session Zaber and Mesoscope position snapshots) and the sollertia-shared-assets Mesoscope-VR record schemas (session descriptors, MesoscopeHardwareState, and MesoscopeExperimentConfiguration trial structures). Optional system plugin layered on the core plugins; relies on and requires both the experiment plugin's sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp) and the assets plugin's sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa mcp).

plugins.name: forging
plugins.description: Umbrella plugin for sollertia-forgery skill systems. Currently ships the behavior processing subsystem (session discovery, batch preparation and execution, output verification, and feather data querying) and is structured to accommodate future forging, managing, and analysis subsystems. Backed by the sollertia-forgery MCP server (sl-mcp).
